state.title: Try tapping Open button

input.command:
/usr/bin/python3 - <<'PY'
try:
    from Quartz.CoreGraphics import CGEventCreateMouseEvent, CGEventPost, kCGEventLeftMouseDown, kCGEventLeftMouseUp, kCGHIDEventTap
    x, y = 640, 1128
    down = CGEventCreateMouseEvent(None, kCGEventLeftMouseDown, (x, y), 0)
    up = CGEventCreateMouseEvent(None, kCGEventLeftMouseUp, (x, y), 0)
    CGEventPost(kCGHIDEventTap, down)
    CGEventPost(kCGHIDEventTap, up)
    print('clicked')
except Exception as e:
    print('ERR', e)
PY
